title: What If You Could Eat Sunlight?

end.sub: Follow for a new What if every day

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: What if you could *eat sunlight*?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Meet Jay. Jay is broke. *Ketchup soup* broke.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Bit, lunch costs fifteen dollars. I have *four*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Then meet my new hero. A *sea slug*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: It eats algae and keeps their *solar panels*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Tiny green parts that make sugar *from light*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: It turns green and can go *months* without eating.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Months? Without *food*?

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: So I made a smoothie. Algae, plus *my code*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Bit, it smells like a *pond*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Drink it. Then go stand in the *sun*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Jay drinks it. Every last, *slimy* drop.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Nothing happens. For one *full* minute.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Then his hands start to turn *green*.

lines.speaker: heroLeaf
lines.say: Bit. Bit! Why am I a *salad*?

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Not a salad. A walking *solar panel*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Jay steps outside into the morning *sun*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: And his stomach stops *growling*.

lines.speaker: heroLeaf
lines.say: I'm full? From just *standing here*?

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Jay. You just ate breakfast. With your *face*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Jay washes dishes at Rosa's Diner. *Minimum wage*.

lines.speaker: chef
lines.say: Jay! You're *green*! Are you sick?

lines.speaker: heroLeaf
lines.say: Never better, Rosa. I skipped lunch. *And dinner*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Every break, Jay stands by the window. Facing *sunlight*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: When the sun moves, Jay *moves*. Like a sunflower.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Mia, his best friend, is not *impressed*.

lines.speaker: friend
lines.say: Jay, you're turning with the sun. It's *creepy*.

lines.speaker: heroLeaf
lines.say: It's free food, Mia. I saved *fifteen dollars*!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: In one week, he saves a hundred and *five*.

lines.speaker: friend
lines.say: Okay, fine. I want one. Give me *the smoothie*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Mia drinks it. Mia turns *green*.

lines.speaker: friendLeaf
lines.say: Oh no. Oh... oh, it's *nice*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: She posts one selfie. Lunch is *free now*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: By midnight, it has *a million* views.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Jay. I have eighty thousand *orders*.

lines.speaker: heroLeaf
lines.say: So we sell it? Bit, we'd be *rich*!

lines.speaker: chef
lines.say: And who eats at my diner when nobody *eats*?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Jay doesn't hear her. He's busy facing *the sun*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Okay. Printing one million *smoothies*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Three days later, half the city is *green*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: At noon, people stand on rooftops, *eating light*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Parking meters now sell *sunny spots*.

lines.speaker: heroLeaf
lines.say: Bit, look at this! We're *famous*!

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: We're also out of algae. The price just *tripled*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Meanwhile, Rosa's Diner. Twelve tables. *Zero* people.

lines.speaker: chef
lines.say: Thirty years. I never had an empty *Friday*.

lines.speaker: heroLeaf
lines.say: It's a slow week, Rosa. They'll *come back*.

lines.speaker: chef
lines.say: Jay. You haven't touched my soup *in a week*.

lines.speaker: chef
lines.say: You said my soup was the *best in town*.

lines.speaker: heroLeaf
lines.say: It is, Rosa. I just don't *need it* now.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Jay looks away. At the window. At *the sun*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: That night, the news says something *nobody* wants.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: On the roofs, a million green faces look *up*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Fourteen days of clouds. *No sun*.

lines.speaker: friendLeaf
lines.say: Jay... what do we eat with *no sun*?

lines.speaker: heroLeaf
lines.say: Bit? What does the slug do *in the dark*?

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: I... may have skipped that *chapter*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Day one of clouds. The green city feels *sleepy*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Day two. People yawn in the middle of *sentences*.

lines.speaker: friendLeaf
lines.say: I'm so tired. Jay, is it *Tuesday*?

lines.speaker: heroLeaf
lines.say: Mia. It's *Saturday*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Day three. A new shop opens. *Sun Minutes*.

lines.speaker: dealer
lines.say: One minute under my lamp. *Ten dollars*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: The line is longer than Rosa's ever was. *Ever*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Jay. Your hundred and five dollars? *Gone*.

lines.speaker: heroLeaf
lines.say: I just need one more hour of *light*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Day four. Jay forgets his own *phone number*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: He sits on the curb. He can't *stand up*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Jay, eat something. Real food. *Please*.

lines.speaker: heroLeaf
lines.say: Food costs money, Bit. I have *nothing*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Then Bit's battery icon flashes *red*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Funny. I run on sunlight too. And I'm *low*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Jay looks at his hands. They're turning *gray*.

lines.speaker: heroGray
lines.say: Bit... is this *permanent*?

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Four percent. Jay, *listen to me*...

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Jay carries Bit across the city. In the *rain*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: To the only lab still open. *Dr. Kai's*.

lines.speaker: scientist
lines.say: You copied a sea slug? With a *smoothie*?

lines.speaker: heroGray
lines.say: It's real! It lives on sunlight *for months*!

lines.speaker: scientist
lines.say: It keeps stolen chloroplasts. That part is *true*.

lines.speaker: scientist
lines.say: But a cousin slug was tested on *light alone*.

lines.speaker: scientist
lines.say: It couldn't grow. Light helps. It doesn't *replace food*.

lines.speaker: heroGray
lines.say: So we were never really *full*?

lines.speaker: scientist
lines.say: Bit's code switched off the feeling. Not the *need*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Jay hasn't eaten real food in *nineteen days*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Neither has *half the city*.

lines.speaker: scientist
lines.say: The cure is simple. One bowl of real *food*.

lines.speaker: heroGray
lines.say: Easy! Everybody just *eats*!

lines.speaker: scientist
lines.say: Jay. Nobody bought food for two weeks. Stores *closed*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Empty shelves. Dark windows. Closed *kitchens*.

lines.speaker: heroGray
lines.say: Not every kitchen. I know *one*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Jay runs to Rosa's Diner. The lights are *off*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: And on the door, a new sign. *For sale*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Jay knocks on the back door. Rosa *opens*.

lines.speaker: chef
lines.say: Jay. You're... *gray*.

lines.speaker: heroGray
lines.say: Rosa, I'm sorry. I made everyone stop *coming*.

lines.speaker: chef
lines.say: Why, Jay? Why did you *really* drink it?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Jay is quiet for a long *time*.

lines.speaker: heroGray
lines.say: Every day, you gave me lunch *for free*.

lines.speaker: heroGray
lines.say: And I could never *pay you back*.

lines.speaker: heroGray
lines.say: I wanted to need nobody. Not even *food*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Rosa says nothing. She turns on *the stove*.

lines.speaker: chef
lines.say: You know what soup is for, Jay? *Sharing*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: A hot bowl lands on the table. Jay *eats*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: For the first time in weeks, he feels *hungry*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: His skin goes from gray, to green, to *pink*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Rosa. It *works*. The cure is *your soup*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: At the lab, Kai plugs Bit into *a lamp*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: I'm back. Did I miss *lunch*?

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Bit. How many people drank the *smoothie*?

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: One million, two hundred *thousand*.

lines.speaker: chef
lines.say: I have one pot. One *pot*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Wait. Everyone who drank it saved *money*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: About fifteen dollars a day. For *two weeks*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: They can pay for food. They can't *get here*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Mia, still green and sleepy, grabs *her phone*.

lines.speaker: friendLeaf
lines.say: One post got us in. One gets us *out*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Bring a pot. Bring a neighbor. Cook at *Rosa's*.

ui.title: SOUP AT ROSA'S
ui.body: bring a pot. bring a neighbor.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: By noon, three hundred people are *cooking*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Rosa runs the kitchen like a *general*.

lines.speaker: chef
lines.say: More onions! Less *talking*!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Bit drives the soup cart through the *rain*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Bowl after bowl, the city turns *pink* again.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: But with every trip, Bit's battery *drops*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Twenty percent. Ten. It's fine. I'm *fine*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Bit, stop! You'll shut down *again*!

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Then let me do *one more* street.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: By midnight, the whole city has eaten. *Everyone*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Bit rolls back into the diner and goes *dark*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Bit? Bit! Somebody get *a lamp*!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Outside, after two weeks, the clouds finally *open*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Morning. One sunbeam lands on Bit's *screen*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Power at one percent. Good *morning*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Bit! Don't you *ever* do that again!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: The whole city is pink again. And *hungry*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Rosa's Diner has a line around the *block*.

lines.speaker: chef
lines.say: Thirty years. My best Friday *ever*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Rosa takes down the *for sale* sign.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Rosa, let me pay you back. *Every* bowl.

lines.speaker: chef
lines.say: Then wash the dishes, Jay. Paid. *Full time*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Mia orders the biggest pancakes on the *menu*.

lines.speaker: friend
lines.say: Sunlight is great. But it has no *syrup*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Fun fact. Some sea slugs drop their own *head*.

set.headline: REAL: THE SLUG THAT LOSES ITS HEAD

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: The head regrows a whole body in *three weeks*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Bit. Do *not* put that in a smoothie.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Jay eats lunch at Rosa's every day. And *pays*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: But at noon, he still turns toward *the sun*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Jay. Don't move. There's a *leaf* on your head.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Bit. Was there algae in my *soup*?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Follow for a new What if every day.
